headline: Hamels and three relievers combine to no-hit Braves
recap: The Phillies no-hit the Atlanta Braves 7-0 at Turner Field. Cole Hamels worked six hitless innings, then Jake Diekman, Ken Giles and Jonathan Papelbon each threw a scoreless inning to finish it off, completing a combined no-hitter.
Hamels walked five and hit one batter but allowed no hits, striking out seven on 108 pitches. Braves starter Julio Teheran took the loss, allowing two earned runs over six and two-thirds innings.

Ben Revere drove in five of the Phillies' seven runs, capped by a bases-loaded triple in the seventh that scored Domonic Brown, Cody Asche and Grady Sizemore, and an RBI single in the ninth. Jimmy Rollins also tripled in a run, in the sixth.
